findings.title: Eleven wall-hung bodies (plus two through-wall hydrants) have their covering backing band on the opposite face of the wall; the coverage check ignores face

evidence.measured: Of 91 wall-mounted bodies a band covers by station and height, 78 sit on the band's face and 13 do not, 11 of them stud-cavity cases (canvas attachment_face and the body footprint centroid's side of the wall axis both agree). BK-M-HS1-MID (49.5-53.25 AFF, purpose 'FURN-M-BATH2-CAB-W/-E bottom fastening') and BK-M-HS1-HIGH (78-85.25, 'suspension rail') author no face, so they default to face='left' (north, the powder room), but both BATH2 wall cabinets stand on the south (right) face, body centroid 6.3 in. south of the axis; the 1.5 in. board sits in the far half of a 5.5 in. stud cavity, ~4 in. behind a screw's reach. Same on W-M-C5 BK-M-C5-MID (over-fridge/freezer cabinets, right face, band left), W-M-C2 BK-M-C2-MIRROR-LO (RC2 is right), W-M-S2 BK-M-S2-ROD (stair light is right), W-M-TUBDK-W AP frames (right vs left), W-S-BD-N VANITY-FOOT (body left, band right). The other two of the 13, FX-M-PORCH-HYD (W-M-S1) and FX-S-BALCONY-HYD (W-S-S1, 13 in. walls), are through-wall hydrants and probably benign. advisory.wall_backing_present passes all of them: _band_spans/_covers_station read station and height only. TODO.md L256 names the missing face grade.
evidence.expected: Band face equals the body's attachment face (or the body's side of the axis) for every body the check calls 'backed'; the check should FAIL a wrong-face band.

findings.title: R602.6 edge rule (5/8 in.) is graded as if every bore were centred; 57 stud crossings have the pipe edge 0.04-0.62 in. from the stud face and still PASS

evidence.measured: stud_bore computes edge=(depth-dia)/2 from the diameter alone (mep_bores.py:245) so a 1.9 in. bore in a 2x4 always reads 0.80 in. of wood each side. Using the real run-axis position across the wall vs the stud centre (MemberCut.station, member p0): PR-B-BATH-LAV-VENT crosses W-B-CW2 stud and W-B-CW3 stud 0.73 in. off-centre, leaving 0.07 in. of wood on one side; PR-M-S-VANITY-DRAIN (W-S-BD-N, 1.9 in., offsets -0.5/+0.45) leaves 0.30 in.; PR-A-STUBATH-LAV-ARM (W-A-STU-N, 1.9 in., offset -0.53) 0.27 in.; staggered walls W-S-SN3/W-S-BD-N pass 0.62-0.88 in. lines through every alternate row 1.0 in. off stud centre (0.31-0.44 in. left). 57 crossings in 25 run/wall pairs on 12 walls have 0 <= edge < 0.625 in.; 36 more clip a stud corner (pipe edge outside the stud) and are graded as full bores. All 229 stud-category crossings read PASS (or 2 UNKNOWN cripple). The 1.9 in. cases are the ones where the shortfall is a real hole against 5/8 in.
evidence.expected: Pipe edge >= 0.625 in. from both faces of every bored stud (R602.6), graded from the run's actual across-wall offset; a clipped corner graded as a notch.
evidence.method: Probe /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/F2/p11.py: legs via leg_crossings; across(run at station) minus across(stud p0), edge=min((pc-r)-(sc-d/2),(sc+d/2)-(pc+r)).

findings.source: IRC R602.6 as encoded in mep_bores.STUD_EDGE_CLEAR_IN; framing_bore_limits.md s1 ('5/8 in. of stud must remain either side'); R602.6 percentages and the R602.6.1 tie numbers agree with ICC CodeNotes (2021 IRC) but the 5/8 in. verbatim text was not retrievable (icc codes site 403)
findings.proposed_fix: Pass the run's lateral offset into stud_bore (edge from the real position, notch rule for a clipped corner) and re-centre PR-B-BATH-LAV-VENT, PR-M-S-VANITY-DRAIN, PR-A-STUBATH-LAV-ARM in their bays.
